research.title: Probability Calibration Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments comparing temperature scaling and isotonic regression under controlled covariate shifts, separating calibration fitting from held-out evaluation.
Analyzed reliability diagrams, Brier scores, and subgroup calibration errors to examine how shifted feature distributions affected predicted probabilities.

research.title: Sensitivity of Tabular Classifiers to Missing Data
bullets: Designed comparisons of median and iterative imputation across simulated missingness mechanisms, using shared data splits and matched classifier settings.
Analyzed discrimination and calibration across missingness patterns, examining whether observed differences depended on feature correlations or imputation choices.

research.title: Model Selection for Classification with Noisy Labels
bullets: Designed experiments evaluating regularized logistic regression and gradient boosting under symmetric and class-dependent label corruption, with separate clean test sets.
Analyzed how validation label quality affected hyperparameter selection, using repeated splits and bootstrap intervals to characterize variability in model comparisons.

publications.title: Validation Label Quality and Model Selection Under Symmetric and Class-Dependent Label Noise

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression pipelines with standardized predictors, selecting regularization parameters through cross-validation without exposing held-out test data.
Compared prediction error and coefficient stability on synthetic datasets with correlated features, examining sensitivity to noise and regularization strength.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Clustering and Initialization Sensitivity
bullets: Implemented expectation-maximization for Gaussian mixtures with diagonal and full covariance matrices, including convergence checks and safeguards for nearly singular estimates.
Compared clustering assignments and held-out likelihood against k-means and reference mixture implementations, examining sensitivity to initialization and overlapping component distributions.

projects.title: Bootstrap Aggregation for Decision Tree Regression
bullets: Implemented bootstrap aggregation around decision tree regressors, tracking out-of-bag predictions and comparing aggregated estimates with individual tree predictions.
Evaluated bagged trees and random forests using matched validation splits, examining prediction variability and error across tree depths and feature subsampling settings.
